in_greek.name: Γλυνιάς
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word 'γλυκός' (glukos) meaning 'sweet' and 'νίος' (nios) meaning 'mountain'. It may be interpreted as 'sweet mountain' or 'mountain of strength'.

in_english.name: Glynias
in_english.long_meaning: A name derived from the Old English 'glen' meaning 'valley' and 'i' meaning 'yea' or 'yes', and 'as' meaning 'man'. It may be interpreted as 'yes, man of the valley' or 'man of the strong valley'.
